title: Asahina Mafuyu — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright! Girls, if you would do the honors♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. Let's do it, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You got it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Your special seat is over here, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh... Um, okay.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, is everyone ready?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here we go... We would like to wish you a happy birthday with a song, Asahina! Please listen!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (So those instruments were Hoshino's and the others... I had a feeling.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shall we start getting ready too, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I really didn't expect a performance from you all. Thank you. It was wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We wanted to make sure our feelings came across in our performance. I'm glad you enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone☆ Next up, we have...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hinomori and Airi! Take it away!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh? Another performance?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We also wanted to sing and express our feelings for you today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Feel free to join in the fun too, everyone! Let's have a great time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Everyone...looks like they're having fun.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We wanted to make sure our feelings came across in our performance. I'm glad you enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We also wanted to sing and express our feelings for you today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um... So Asahina, how did you find it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It was great. I really enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was a little surprised by the sudden show... But it made me happy to hear you all sing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: However... Why a show?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The truth is... I asked Mizuki for help.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I wanted to throw a party for your birthday, but I wasn't exactly sure about what to do...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's when Mizuki suggested singing, since music is so important to you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. So Mizuki was the one...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm sure there's a bunch of things planned for you behind the scenes.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (So that's what that was...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for putting in so much thought just for me. It means a lot.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But, the special segment is far from over! Next up will be our turn!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Your turn as in...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's right☆ I actually prepared a video with some special someones! Firstly, a message for you!

rows.Speaker: Rui's Voice
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Asahina. We heard about the party from Emu. It's not much, but we would also like to be a part of the celebration.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <It is your birthday, after all! We have put our all into it, so we hope you enjoy!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Was that Tenma and Kamishiro?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They helped me come up with a way to wish you a happy birthday☆ So we made you an original birthday song! Please listen!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: An original birthday song? Hehe, I wonder what it sounds like.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ Then without further ado, I'll press play.

Lake

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, once again... Happy birthday, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know this will be your second party, Mafuyu, but let's all have a fun time too♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Second party?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mafuyu had a party at school too. How did it go?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I received an original birthday song.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And... Some of my juniors performed a song for me, while two girls from my year who are also working as idols sang and danced.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Wait, so Saki and gang, and Shizuku and Airi performed live just for you?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: T-That's—

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So unfair!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought you knew? Hinomori said that she asked for your help.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, she did. But I didn't know that that's what they came up with in the end!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Based on Mizuki's reaction, they must be pretty amazing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Of course! We're talking about an up-and-coming band and idols that are already famous!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And they performed for you live for free! I'm so jealous....

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, that's because it's a special birthday gift, no?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's true.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But, an original birthday song... That sounds like a lovely present.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It was.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think it was a nice song.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, then we should sing too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? We should?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, I don't want to be left behind when it comes to celebrating Mafuyu's birthday! It'd be nice to sing with those feelings in mind, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh... I-In that case, I'd like to sing too...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's more like it! Since it's an occasion, MEIKO, KAITO, would you like to join too?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Do what you want.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm fine to just listen.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Birthday or not, they're the same as usual...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha. If you ever feel like it, then join in whenever! Alright, I hope you enjoy this, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Asahina. We heard from Akito it was your birthday, so we wanted to give you our well-wishes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Seriously, you could have told us sooner, Akito. We could've prepared a gift!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well this is how we're doing it, so stop complaining.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Um... Sorry about that, Asahina. Please let us celebrate with you another time. Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here we go, everyone! Ready, go! Happy birthday, Asahina☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Rui
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ We worked really hard on the celebrations, so I hope you had a fun time at today's party!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We heard from Emu that you enjoyed our original birthday song! I'm glad to hear it as the lyricist!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We did struggle quite a bit on finding a way to express our feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We decided to go with a video, but... I hope our feelings reached you, even just a little bit. Happy birthday, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Asahina! I'm so glad that you enjoyed the party today. Let's invite Mizuki and Ena, and all go out somewhere together sometime soon.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sounds lovely! I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's have lunch together again sometime when our schedules match up, Asahina. Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Asahina! Thank you so much for spending time with us today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm glad you enjoyed our performance. It made all of the practicing worth it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You all were really pulling out all the stops. I think you can pat yourselves on the back, considering the results.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. We put a lot of heart and soul into it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I hope our feelings reach you. Happy birthday, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Mafuyu! How did you like our song?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We made sure to give it our all to measure up to everyone at Miya Girls, so I hope you liked it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It was a rowdier party than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But, looks like you enjoyed yourself. Happy birthday, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It also makes me happy to celebrate your birthday like this with everyone, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Once again, happy birthday. Also... I'm going to keep composing. So that I can save you one day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thanks to everyone at school and in SEKAI, I got to listen to a lot of songs.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All songs full of feelings, huh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't exactly know what feelings were in there, but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They were all good songs, I think.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for wishing me a happy birthday.
